subject: A few more places left for our North America introductory workshop

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: A few more places left for our North America introductory workshop
parts:
Those of you debating whether to attend the Introductory distance
sampling workshop 12-15 July in La Jolla CA, there are yet a couple of
seats left, but to reserve a place please act by Monday 1 June. Please
see the website http://www.cetus.ucsd.edu/Distance.html for full details
on the venue (Scripps Institute of Oceanography), registration,
accommodation, etc.

--
Eric Rexstad
